applies_why: The judge text treats Isaiah 7:14's answered wording and prophetic application as leaving the issue UNDERDETERMINED, which invokes the rule about verses carrying two senses.
quote: D5 vs C5 (Isaiah 7:14): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the virgin and young-woman wording in [DR3] and defender answered the prophetic application in [CR2] and [CR3].
rule_words: A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.
room: A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand: I weighed (1) this bars an UNDERDETERMINED verdict when two live senses are answered, against (2) it only covers express reliance on one verse not stating a link; I adopt (1).
why: The judge text treats Isaiah 7:14's answered wording and prophetic application as leaving the issue underdetermined, contrary to K-S2's command that a two-sense verse is not open and both senses stand.
